title: Expanding Cardano's Reach: Equipping the Community for Cross-Chain & Mainstream User Onboarding via Proof Of Onboarding (P.O.O.)

ms.promise:
・Proof Of Onboarding (P.O.O.) tool ready for deployment at upcoming crypto events, optimized for efficiency and user experience.
・A comprehensive Quick Reference Guide for effectively utilizing the Proof Of Onboarding process.
・Detailed documentation to support the Proof Of Onboarding process, ensuring clarity and accessibility for all users.
・Development of community empowerment resources, including a blueprint and an onboarding playbook, to enable the Cardano community to replicate success at various events.
ms.criteria:
・The Proof Of Onboarding tool's efficiency validation, ensuring a user onboarding time of under 2 minutes, can be verified through a demonstration video linked provided.
・The Quick Reference Guide can be accessed by the Milestone Reviewer on PDF/URL.
・Development of community resources, including a detailed blueprint and an onboarding playbook with actionable strategies for engaging new users, is documented and available for the Milestone Reviewer's examination at a specified PDF/URL.
ms.report:
Proof of Achievement – Milestone 1: Event Preparation and Onboarding Process Documentation
We have completed Milestone 1, delivering all required outputs and evidence for the Proof of Onboarding (P.O.O.) tool.
Outputs Achieved
・Functional and Optimized P.O.O. Tool – Fully operational and ready for deployment at crypto events, enabling wallet creation and token airdrops in under 2 minutes via QR code scanning.
・Quick Reference Guide – Concise, step-by-step guide for onboarding attendees.
・Detailed Documentation & Community Empowerment Materials – Combined in the Onboarding Playbook and Blueprint, which includes the full onboarding walkthrough, engagement tips, FAQs, troubleshooting, and guidance for replication by other Cardano community members.

Evidence
 A public Google Drive folder contains all deliverables for this milestone, including:
・Quick Reference Guide & documentation (PDF)
・Onboarding Playbook and Blueprint v.69 (PDF)
・Demo video showing the P.O.O. tool in action, completing onboarding from QR code scan to funded wallet in under 2 minutes

Public Resource Folder

ms.promise:
・Active participation in ETHDenver and Paris Blockchain Week.
・Distribution of Proof Of Onboarding Cards to attendees at both events.
・Comprehensive reports on card distribution, wallet creation data, and subsequent wallet usage postsignup.
ms.criteria:
・Documented proof of the number of Proof Of Onboarding Cards distributed at both events, including photographs, videos, or other evidence via URL/Google Drive.
・Data on the number of wallets created using the distributed cards, indicating successful onboarding to be made available to reviewers via URL/PDF.
・Analysis of post signup wallet activity to evaluate ongoing user engagement to be provided to reviewers via URL/PDF.
ms.report:
A. Output: Active participation in ETHDenver and Paris Blockchain Week.
Acceptance criteria: Documented proof of the number of Proof Of Onboarding Cards distributed at both events, including photographs, videos, or other evidence via URL/Google Drive.
Evidence: Photos and videos from both events sit in the linked Google Drive folder. It includes booth coverage from ETHDenver, distribution shots from Paris Blockchain Week, and clips of attendees scanning the cards on the floor.
→ Milestone 2 PoA Folder with Full Report and Pictures
B. Output: Distribution of Proof Of Onboarding Cards to attendees at both events.
Acceptance criteria: Data on the number of wallets created using the distributed cards, indicating successful onboarding, made available to reviewers via URL/PDF.
Evidence: Attendees redeemed 439 P.O.O. codes in total: 231 at ETHDenver and 208 at Paris Blockchain Week. Each redemption created a new Cardano wallet via the CIP-99 airdrop flow, and every transaction is verifiable on Cardano mainnet. The linked PoA report (PDF) breaks the numbers down by event, with claim windows and redemption counts. Source wallet addresses are kept internal but can be shared with reviewers on request.
Post-signup activity by event:
・ETHDenver — 231 claims, 31 active post-signup (13.4%)
・Paris Blockchain Week — 208 claims, 36 active post-signup (17.3%)
・MS2 total — 439 claims, 67 active post-signup (15.3%)

→ Milestone 2 PoA Folder with Full Report and Pictures
C. Output: Comprehensive reports on card distribution, wallet creation data, and subsequent wallet usage post-signup.
Acceptance criteria: Analysis of post-signup wallet activity to evaluate ongoing user engagement, plus a detailed assessment report of onboarding effectiveness and adjustments made based on performance at both events, provided to reviewers via URL/PDF.
